beats.says: Node 0 leads three acceptors. Beside them run two proxy leaders, two replicas and a batcher. Each one is its own process.
The client writes alpha. Node 0 only gives it a slot and hands it to a proxy leader: slot 0 goes to proxy leader 0.
Proxy leader 1 takes slot 1. It sends the Accepts to the whole majority, counts the votes and tells every learner. The replicas learn the log and vote on nothing.
Node 0 sent one message for each write. The proxies did the rest.
A proxy leader casts no vote, and a replica runs no command: they move work.
Now choose a case.

choices.label: Before: the leader does all the work
A vote to a proxy is lost
A proxy meets a newer ballot

scenarios.outcome: Chosen: slot 0 = alpha, slot 1 = bravo. Replica 0 learned to slot 1, replica 1 learned to slot 1.

beats.says: Node 1 starts an election, and node 0 does not hear of it. Nodes 1 and 2 promise the newer ballot.
Node 0 still thinks it leads. The client writes alpha, and proxy leader 0 sends the Accepts at the old ballot.
Nodes 1 and 2 promised the newer ballot, so they refuse with a Nack. The proxy closes the round and passes the Nack to node 0, and node 0 stops leading.
The proxy votes on nothing and decides nothing: it closes the round and the leader learns that it lost.

scenarios.outcome: Chosen: no chosen slot. Replica 0 learned nothing, replica 1 learned nothing.
